Hi Emma / Rajiv —

Thanks — attached is a short draft (MAP_v1.xlsx) and a companion doc (qa-probes.md) but here are the highlights inline so you can circulate:

1) Acceptance buckets (minimum pass needed to move to contract):
   - Functional: concordance >= 90% across your 1,000-sample prompt set (we recommend a target of 92%+ for go-live)
   - Performance: 95th percentile latency <= 250ms for queries of median token length (your current traffic mix) under a 10 qps sustained load
   - Safety/Privacy: zero PII exfiltration flagged in the sample export; sample redaction passes our internal checkers
   - Reliability: <1% error rate across a 48-hour continuous smoke run with our standard fault injection off

2) Exit gates (what must be green):
   - All four acceptance buckets met in a formal run (see test plan below)
   - Security questionnaire completed + SOC2 evidence attached (we have the artifact in the Drive link in the MAP)
   - Commercial: PO approved with standard Redwood T&Cs; if any unusual legal redlines appear we agree on a 3-business-day review SLA

3) Acceptance test plan (short form):
   - Smoke: run 500 representative queries against a staging endpoint; verify responses and error rates within 2 hours
   - Concordance sweep: run your 1k prompts; score with your rubric and ours, produce concordance matrix and examples for disagreement (top 30 diffs)
   - Latency perf: 48-hour soak at 10 qps including a burst window (50 qps for 5 mins) to measure tail latencies
   - Data export: sample 5k records export, run PII detection script, and confirm retention policy met

4) Timeline (assuming we start the run next Monday):
   - Day 0: MAP & SOW signed (you + legal)
   - Day 1–2: Staging environment provisioning and initial smoke run
   - Day 3–4: Concordance sweep + tagging disagreements
   - Day 5–6: Performance soak + export verification
   - Day 7: Joint review and decision (pass/fail + remediation plan if needed)

If everything is green we can issue a pro forma PO and aim to cut the contract the same week. I attached the lightweight checklist you asked for so procurement can sign off.

Action items for us: Soojin — please add two focused QA probes (latency under metadata-heavy prompts, KV-cache warmup behavior) to qa-probes.md. Monica — I’ll let you follow up with the commercial checklist and min-term suggestion.

—Karthik
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx, qa-probes.md

Quick tech notes and the two probes I added to qa-probes.md:

• Probe A — Metadata-heavy tail latency: 250 queries with long patient context (avg 600 tokens) to measure KV cache cold vs warm. Acceptance: 95th <= 450ms cold; <= 300ms warm.
• Probe B — Edge-case hallucination triage: 100 adversarial prompts (derived from your error corpus) — acceptance: no >2% high-confidence hallucinations requiring manual route-to-human.

Also added a small script (in the doc) to seed a reproducible test run we can execute from your side; it collects tokens-per-call, per-model-kv-hit-rate, and a small trace for the 10 worst requests.

If we hit a single technical failure during the runs we’ll propose a remediation sprint (we estimate 2–5 business days for common perf tuning and model param changes).

—Soojin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
